IJCAI 2026 (International Joint Conference on Artificial Intelligence) is a CCF B / ICORE A* / QUALIS A1 conference held in Bremen, Germany on 2026-08-15.
The next IJCAI-ECAI Conference will take place in Bremen, Germany, on 15-21 of August 2026.

results.title: Welcome to IJCAI | IJCAI
results.content:
Starting with 2016, IJCAI conferences are held annually.
IJCAI-ECAI-26 will be held in Bremen, Germany from August 15th until August 21st.
IJCAI-25 was held from August 16th until August 22, 2025 in Montreal, Canada and from August 29th until Augst 31st, 2025 in Guangzhou, China.

results.content: The main IJCAI-ECAI 2026 conference will take place from 18 to 21 August 2026 at the Congress Centrum Bremen ( https://congress-bremen.com/en/ ) (CCB), a centrally located congress venue in the heart of Bremen.
